# Toggle

A two-state button (aria-pressed). Use for a single on/off option such as a formatting or view mode.

## Import

```tsx
import { Toggle, toggleVariants } from "@cesuain/ui";
// or the per-component entry point
import { Toggle } from "@cesuain/ui/toggle";
```

Types: `ToggleProps`.

Props, defaults and live examples are on the Storybook Docs page, generated from the TypeScript types.

- Behaviour and semantics are summarized above; keyboard and screen reader behaviour follow the WAI-ARIA pattern of the underlying primitive.
- `toggle.test.tsx` covers rendering, variants and interaction with Testing Library and runs axe-core on the rendered output (contrast is checked at token level). Every story also runs axe-core's default rule set in the Storybook browser tests; violations fail the run.
